blocks.title: Enthalpy change of neutralization
blocks.text: Standard enthalpy change of neutralization woh enthalpy change hai jo tab hoti hai jab acid aur alkali ke reaction se standard conditions par pani ka ek mole banta hai.
Yeh hamesha exothermic hoti hai. Misal: HCl se NaOH ki neutralization ki enthalpy –57.1 kJ mol⁻¹ hai.

Jab yeh solutions milaye jate hain to asal mein sirf ek hi tabdeeli hoti hai: pani ke molecules bante hain, aur Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ solution mein azad ions ki tarah waise hi rehte hain. Is liye neutralization ki enthalpy asal mein ions se ek mole liquid pani banne ki heat hai, aur asal neutralization reaction yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l)    ΔH°n = –57.1 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Tamam strong acid aur strong base ke reactions mein ΔH°n taqreeban –57.1 kJ mol⁻¹ hi hota hai.

blocks.prompt: KOH aur HNO₃ ki neutralization enthalpy NaOH aur HCl jitni kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono strong acid aur strong alkali hain, solution mein poori tarah ions mein toot jate hain. K⁺ aur NO₃⁻ bhi Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ ki tarah waise hi rehte hain; asal reaction har dafa H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l) hai, is liye har mole pani par taqreeban 57.1 kJ heat nikalti hai.

items: ΔH°n: acid aur alkali se ek mole pani; hamesha exothermic; strong acid aur base ke liye taqreeban –57.1 kJ mol⁻¹, kyun ke asal reaction sirf H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O hai.
